import re
src = open('corpus/SOURCES.md').read()
for sid in ('S047','S048'):
    m = re.search(r'^#+\s*'+sid+r'\b.*?(?=^#+\s*\S|\Z)', src, re.S|re.M)
    print('==== '+sid+' ====')
    print(m.group(0)[:3000] if m else 'NOT FOUND')
pit = open('corpus/knowledge/incremental-pin-disposition.md').read()
print('==== PIT item-4 context ====')
for m in re.finditer(r'prioritisation|reuse skip|item 4', pit):
    print(pit[max(0,m.start()-300):m.start()+300].replace(chr(10),' | '))
print('==== pin-disposition failed-arm ====')
tool = open('tools/pin-disposition.py').read()
for m in re.finditer(r'exit\(1\)|return 1|"failed"|\x27failed\x27|1 failed', tool):
    print(tool[max(0,m.start()-200):m.start()+200].replace(chr(10),' | '))
